blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Davaoeno Braebon Ali Thompson continues to lead the Most Valuable Player (MVP) race in the Cebu Schools Athletic Foundation, Inc. (Cesafi) Season 26 men’s basketball tournament as the second round of the elimination phase heats up. The rookie Cebu Institute of Technology-University (CIT-U) Wildcats forward has been instrumental in his team’s push for a Final Four berth, helping CIT-U win seven of its 11 games to secure fourth place in the standings. A former Davao Schools Athletic Foundation, Inc. (Dasafi) MVP, Thompson leads the statistical race with 28.7 statistical points, according to Stats Central. READ: Cesafi Season […]...
